What True Autumn looks like

You are the warmest of the autumns: golden, peachy or bronze skin, hair with auburn, copper or golden-brown depth, and warm hazel, amber, green or brown eyes. Earthy, spiced colours such as terracotta, mustard, olive and teal look like they were made for you, while icy pastels, fuchsia and cool greys make you look drained.

Colours True Autumn should avoid

Black. Harsh and cold next to your warmth; chocolate does the job better.

Cool Grey. Steely and flat; it makes golden skin look ashen.

Best metals

Best: Yellow gold. Good: Copper and bronze. Skip: Silver and chrome.

Questions

What colours look best on True Autumn?

True Autumn suits colours that are warm, medium and soft-medium, such as salmon, terracotta, brick, warm apricot, butterscotch.

What colours should True Autumn avoid?

Black: Harsh and cold next to your warmth; chocolate does the job better. Cool Grey: Steely and flat; it makes golden skin look ashen.

Gold or silver for True Autumn?

Best: Yellow gold. Also good: copper and bronze. Usually skip: silver and chrome.

How do I know if I'm True Autumn?

True Autumn colouring is warm in undertone, medium in depth, medium in contrast and soft-medium in chroma. A daylight selfie scan measures all four and shows your closest season plus a runner-up.
